correctness.rationale: Conditioning leaf j means forbidding all independent future parent selections P_k=j, leaving them independent uniform on k-2 eligible parents. This gives exact conditional recurrence a_(k+1)=k a_k/(k-1)+1-H_(j-1)/(k-1), whose solution a_k-E[T_k]=-(H_(k-1)-H_(j-1)). Multiplying by P(leaf j)=(j-1)/(n-1) gives indexed covariance; summation gives -(n-2)/4; adjacent differences and harmonic approximation give strict concavity and e^-1 limit. Independent enumeration of every recursive tree up to n=7 verified exact conditional means and covariances. This mathematical correctness does not imply originality.
